thread.title: Tim Cook says his employees are not focused on Apple’s stock price - MarketWatch

author: MarketWatch
title: Tim Cook says his employees are not focused on Apple’s stock price - MarketWatch
text:
‘I worked at a company a while back, many years ago, where every hallway you go in, you would see their stock price being monitored. You will not find that here.’ Tim Cook That’s Tim Cook, Apple’s CEO, painting a picture of a highly focused atmosphere at the company, during a wide-ranging interview with Fast Company .
The reason, he hastens to add, is not solely that you can now get share-price updates on your iPhone instead.
Cook’s résumé, for readers curious about which past employer he might have been drawing the contrast with, features stints of 12 years and six years, respectively, at IBM IBM, +0.70% and Compaq.
For anyone more interested than the Cook-described Apple AAPL, +1.13% staff in the stock’s minute-to-minute performance, it’s currently up 1.1% at $173.75. So far in 2018, the stock is up 2.4%, as compared with the 2.1% rise of the Dow industrials DJIA, +0.99% . Apple is a Dow stock.
